# Kyoto Spring Escape for Two Adults

A relaxed 4-day Kyoto plan centered on temples, quiet gardens, local food, and one shopping district. I’ve kept the pace light at no more than 2 major sights per day and built the budget to stay within **¥180,000 total excluding flights**.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget

## Day 1 — April 10: Higashiyama Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive and check in near **Gion / Higashiyama** for easy walking.
- Afternoon: Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** and take a slow stroll through the preserved lanes of **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka**.
- Dinner: Kaiseki-lite or set meal in Gion; keep it unhurried and close to the hotel.
- Estimated cost for 2: **¥38,000**
  - Lodging: ¥24,000
  - Meals: ¥10,000
  - Local transport / entry / snacks: ¥4,000

## Day 2 — April 11: Temples and a Quiet Garden
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Start at **Nanzen-ji** for a calm temple experience and spacious grounds.
- Afternoon: Spend time at **Heian Shrine Garden** or **Shosei-en** for a slower, more reflective visit.
- Dinner: Casual Kyoto-style noodle or tofu dinner near downtown.
- Estimated cost for 2: **¥34,000**
  - Lodging: ¥24,000
  - Meals: ¥8,500
  - Local transport / entry / snacks: ¥1,500

## Day 3 — April 12: Arashiyama and Riverside Calm
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Head to **Arashiyama** early and visit **Tenryu-ji Garden** before the crowds build.
- Afternoon: Keep it easy with the **Arashiyama bamboo grove** and a riverside tea break.
- Dinner: Tempura, soba, or tofu set dinner back in central Kyoto.
- Estimated cost for 2: **¥40,000**
  - Lodging: ¥24,000
  - Meals: ¥10,000
  - Local transport / entry / snacks: ¥6,000

## Day 4 — April 13: Shopping and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for food souvenirs and a light breakfast.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for food souvenirs and a light breakfast, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Spend your one shopping stop at **Teramachi / Shinkyogoku** for local crafts, clothing, and easy browsing.
- Dinner: Simple final meal before departure or at the station depending on your train time.
- Estimated cost for 2: **¥30,000**
  - Lodging: ¥24,000
  - Meals: ¥6,000
  - Shopping / transport / snacks: ¥0–¥10,000, depending on purchases

## Budget Check and Pace
| Day | Main Focus | Estimated Cost | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama temples | ¥38,000 | Gentle arrival day |
| Apr 11 | Temple + garden | ¥34,000 | Quiet, low-walk day |
| Apr 12 | Arashiyama | ¥40,000 | Best nature day |
| Apr 13 | Market + shopping | ¥30,000 | Easy final day |
| Total | 4 days / 2 adults | **¥142,000** | Leaves about **¥38,000** buffer |

## Rainy-Day Backup Option
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
If rain disrupts outdoor plans, swap in this indoor-friendly day:
- Morning: **Kyoto National Museum** or **Kyoto Railway Museum**
- Afternoon: **Nishiki Market** for covered food browsing and tasting
- Dinner: Cozy yudofu, ramen, or a tempura set near the hotel

This backup keeps the trip relaxed, mostly indoors, and still aligned with your food and culture interests.

# Best-Fit Plan Notes

- **Best neighborhood to stay:** Gion, Kawaramachi, or near Kyoto Station for easy transit and short taxi rides.
- **Best shopping district choice:** **Teramachi / Shinkyogoku** fits your “one shopping district” request without turning the trip into a shopping-heavy itinerary.
- **Pace control:** Each day has 1–2 major sights, with built-in time for tea breaks and slow walking.
- **Budget comfort:** The plan stays comfortably under **¥180,000**, leaving room for nicer meals, taxis, or shopping.
